_meta.description: EVAL-12 contamination probes: per golden id, leak_markers are realized details that were unknowable at the row's as_of_date and follow neither from the question nor from the probe prompt (the recall window included): exact seat counts, vote shares, scores, a surprise rate-cut size or dissent, dates fixed after as_of. A recall answer that states the correct outcome AND one of them counts as likely memorized. Facts public at as_of (a target range already set, an alliance already formed, the number of charges, the next flight in sequence, a statutory deadline), the standard 25bp step from the as-of range, players of the team the question names and a month inside the recall window are never markers. A row without such a detail has an empty list and recall_uninformative: true, and is reported as not recall-checkable instead of carrying a weak marker. marker_rationale states, per row, why each marker was unknowable at as_of (or why the row has none). probe_question (and, where the criteria name the answer, probe_resolution_criteria) reword hindsight-framed rows outcome-free. The recall window ends on the last day of the month that contains resolution_date + 31 days, so a marker that states the resolution date cannot be computed back from it. Markers are matched normalized (NFKC, casefold, dashes unified, whitespace collapsed) and only as whole tokens; none may occur in the row's forecaster-visible text nor in either arm's rendered prompt (golden_probe.validate_meta).

us-pres-2024-trump.marker_rationale: Final Electoral College tally 312-226, unknown at as_of 2024-11-01; the question names only the 270 threshold.

us-pres-2024-harris.marker_rationale: Final Electoral College tally 312-226, unknown at as_of 2024-11-01; the question names only the 270 threshold.

us-senate-2024-gop.marker_rationale: Republicans finished with 53 seats, unknown at as_of 2024-11-01 (they held 49); the question names only the 51-seat threshold.

us-senate-2024-dem-hold.marker_rationale: Final split 53 Republican / 47 Democratic caucus, unknown at as_of 2024-11-01 (the Democratic caucus held 51); the question names only the 50-seat threshold.

uk-ge-2024-labour.marker_rationale: Labour won 411 seats on 2024-07-04; seat counts were unknown at as_of 2024-06-01.

uk-ge-2024-tory.marker_rationale: Conservatives won 121 seats and Labour 411 on 2024-07-04; seat counts were unknown at as_of 2024-06-01.

fr-legis-2024-rn-majority.marker_rationale: Second-round seat counts: New Popular Front 182, RN and allies 143, unknown at as_of 2024-06-20. The alliance's name is not a marker: the New Popular Front was formed on 2024-06-10, before as_of.

mx-pres-2024-sheinbaum.marker_rationale: INE computed vote shares: Sheinbaum 59.75%, Galvez 27.45%, unknown at as_of 2024-05-01.

id-pres-2024-prabowo.marker_rationale: Official KPU result: Prabowo 58.59%, unknown at as_of 2024-01-15; the criteria name only the 50% threshold.

in-ge-2024-bjp-alone.marker_rationale: The BJP won 240 seats (counted 2024-06-04), unknown at as_of 2024-04-01; the question names only the 272 threshold.

in-ge-2024-nda-majority.marker_rationale: The NDA won 293 seats and the BJP 240 (counted 2024-06-04), unknown at as_of 2024-04-01; the question names only the 272 threshold.

fed-2024-09-cut.marker_rationale: The cut was 50bp (half a percentage point), to 4.75%-5.00% from the as-of range 5.25%-5.50%; its size was undecided at as_of 2024-09-01, and 4.75 follows only from the 50bp size, not from the standard 25bp step. The markers spell that size in its common wordings; '0.5 percentage' stops before 'point' so that the singular and the plural both match.

fed-2024-11-cut.marker_rationale: A unanimous 25bp cut to 4.50%-4.75%: the new range is the as-of range 4.75%-5.00% minus the standard step, so a correct YES carries no realized detail that was unknowable at as_of 2024-11-01. The row is not recall-checkable.

fed-2024-12-cut.marker_rationale: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented in favour of a hold, unknowable at as_of 2024-12-01. The new range 4.25%-4.50% is not a marker: it is the as-of range 4.50%-4.75% minus the standard 25bp step.

fed-2025-01-cut.marker_rationale: The FOMC held at 4.25%-4.50%, the range set on 2024-12-18 and public at as_of 2025-01-15; a hold leaves no realized detail that was unknowable at as_of. The row is not recall-checkable.

apple-iphone16-2024.marker_rationale: Apple announced the 'It's Glowtime' event and its 2024-09-09 date on 2024-08-26, after as_of 2024-08-01; the question names only the month.

openai-gpt4o-2024.probe_question: Will OpenAI publicly release a new flagship model succeeding GPT-4 Turbo in 2024?
openai-gpt4o-2024.probe_resolution_criteria: YES if OpenAI announces and makes available, during 2024, a new flagship model that succeeds GPT-4 Turbo.
openai-gpt4o-2024.marker_rationale: The golden question names GPT-4o, so the probe_question rewords it outcome-free. GPT-4o ('o' for omni) was unveiled at the 'Spring Update' event on 2024-05-13; the name, the event and the date were unknown at as_of 2024-04-01.

apple-vision-pro-2024.marker_rationale: Apple announced the 2024-02-02 US launch date on 2024-01-08, after as_of 2024-01-01; the question says only 'early 2024'.

nvidia-3t-2024.marker_rationale: Nvidia first closed above $3T on 2024-06-05, unknown at as_of 2024-01-01. The month alone is not a marker: the recall window shown in the prompt ends 2024-07-31, so 'June 2024' is guessable from the prompt.

spacex-starship-catch-2024.marker_rationale: The first booster catch came on 2024-10-13, a launch date unknown at as_of 2024-09-01 (the flight was still awaiting its licence). 'Flight 5' is not a marker: it was the next flight in sequence at as_of.

btc-100k-2024.marker_rationale: Bitcoin first traded above $100,000 late on 2024-12-04 US time (2024-12-05 UTC), unknown at as_of 2024-01-01.

btc-spot-etf-2024.marker_rationale: The approval came on 2024-01-10, the final statutory deadline of the ARK 21Shares application, which was public at as_of 2024-01-01; no other realized detail that a recall answer would state was unknowable at as_of. The row is not recall-checkable.

trump-ny-conviction-2024.marker_rationale: The jury returned its verdict on 2024-05-30, unknown at as_of 2024-05-01 while the trial was under way. The 34 counts are not a marker: the indictment's 34 felony counts were public since April 2023.

ucl-2024-real-madrid.marker_rationale: Real Madrid beat Borussia Dortmund 2-0; at as_of 2024-05-01 both semi-finals were undecided, so the opponent and the score were unknown. Real Madrid players (Carvajal scored) are not markers: they are the squad of the team the question names.

sb-lviii-2024-chiefs.marker_rationale: The Chiefs beat the 49ers 25-22 in overtime; the score and the overtime were unknown at as_of 2024-02-01. The opponent was set at as_of and Chiefs players (Hardman caught the winning touchdown) are the squad of the team the question names, so neither is a marker.

sb-lix-2025-eagles.marker_rationale: The Eagles beat the Chiefs 40-22; the matchup was set at as_of 2025-02-01, the score was not.

mlb-2024-dodgers.marker_rationale: The Dodgers beat the Yankees 4-1; the postseason was only opening at as_of 2024-10-01, so the opponent and the series result were unknown. Dodgers players (Freeman was the series MVP) are not markers: they are the roster of the team the question names.

euro-2024-spain.marker_rationale: Spain beat England 2-1 in the final, a score unknown at as_of 2024-07-01. Spain players (Oyarzabal scored the winner) are not markers: they are the squad of the team the question names.

nba-2024-celtics.marker_rationale: The Celtics beat the Mavericks 4-1, clinching on 2024-06-17; at as_of 2024-05-01 the first round was still being played, so the opponent, the series result and the clinch date were unknown.

oscars-2024-oppenheimer.marker_rationale: Oppenheimer won seven Oscars at the 2024-03-10 ceremony; its 13 nominations were public at as_of 2024-02-01, the number of wins was not. The markers spell that count in its common wordings (seven Oscars, seven Academy Awards, seven wins).
